## What changed

Describe the change and the user or contributor problem it addresses.

## Related issue or decision

Link the issue and any affected ADR.

## Validation

List the checks performed and their results.

## Privacy and security

Describe effects on local data, credentials, AI-provider requests, logs, exports, or deletion. Write `None` when there is no effect.

## Visual evidence

Add screenshots or recordings for visible UI changes, using fictional data only.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is within the approved requirement and architecture scope.
- [ ] No secrets or real personal data are included.
- [ ] Documentation and decision records are updated where needed.
- [ ] Tests or proportionate validation are included.
- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated generated files.
